parsed.rationale: Both participating records — `AudioPlayerCoreStateTests.isPlayingFalseAfterStop` (line 88) and `AudioPlayerIdempotencyTests.playAfterStopWorks` (line 164) — carry `is_test: true` in their context flags. Although the two methods share a Jaccard similarity of 0.7, they belong to distinct test classes (`AudioPlayerCoreStateTests` and `AudioPlayerIdempotencyTests`) that are intentionally testing different behavioural facets of the audio player: core state transitions versus idempotency of the play-after-stop sequence. Merging or deduplicating test methods across semantically distinct test classes would obscure test intent and couple unrelated failure surfaces. No production code is involved, so no shared-code benefit accrues.
